title: AINM Protocol - Streaming Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for the streaming lifecycle: StreamStart, StreamDelta, StreamEnd, CancelStream. See streaming.md.

BlockLayoutEntry.description: Declares a content block's type, version, and source within the stream-start block layout. Layout is immutable after stream-start. See streaming.md Section 3.1.

type.description: Content block type. In v1, only 'text' and 'code' blocks are streamable.

version.description: Block type schema version in MAJOR.MINOR format.

StreamStart.description: Initiates a new stream and declares the complete block layout upfront. Delivered as ainm.stream.start JSON-RPC notification. See streaming.md Section 3.1.

stream_id.description: Unique identifier for this stream. All subsequent events reference this stream_id.

message_id.description: Pre-assigned message ID for the collapsed permanent message.

thread_id.description: Target thread. All stream events are scoped to this thread.

blocks.description: Ordered array of block layout declarations. Immutable for the duration of the stream. Per Phase 2 decision: block layout immutable after stream-start.

StreamDelta.description: Delivers incremental content tokens to a specific block. Ephemeral JSON-RPC notification, session-authenticated, not individually signed. See streaming.md Section 3.2.

stream_id.description: References the stream_id from the corresponding StreamStart.

block_index.description: Zero-based index into the blocks array from stream-start. Identifies which block this delta appends to.

delta.description: Incremental content to append. Typically 1 to a few tokens. MUST NOT be empty.

language.description: Programming language identifier for code blocks. Included on the first delta for a code block to enable syntax highlighting.

StreamEnd.description: Terminates a stream and triggers collapse into a permanent signed message. See streaming.md Section 3.3 and Section 4.

stream_id.description: References the stream_id from the corresponding StreamStart.

status.description: Terminal status of the stream. 'completed' triggers full collapse; 'cancelled' triggers partial collapse.

CancelStream.description: Client-initiated request to cancel a stream. Sent as ainm.stream.cancel JSON-RPC request. See streaming.md Section 5.

stream_id.description: The stream_id of the stream to cancel.

StreamErrorNotification.description: Reports a streaming error that terminates the stream abnormally. Sent as ainm.stream.error JSON-RPC notification. See streaming.md Section 6.

stream_id.description: The stream_id of the affected stream.

code.description: Error code from the streaming error range (-32040 to -32049).

partial_preserved.description: Whether partial content accumulated before the error is preserved as a permanent message.

StreamingErrorCodes.description: Streaming-specific JSON-RPC error codes in the range -32040 to -32044. See streaming.md Section 6.

codes.description: Error code definitions for streaming errors.

-32040.description: The referenced stream_id does not correspond to an active stream.

-32041.description: A delta referenced a block_index outside the declared block layout range.

-32042.description: A delta or cancel was received for a stream that has already terminated.

-32043.description: A delta targeted a block type that is not streamable in v1 (only text and code are streamable).

-32044.description: The server or client does not support streaming (streaming capability not negotiated during initialize).
